decision.rationale: Every one of the thirteen attacks the prompt names is refuted, and five further attacks of this reviewer's own were run and also refuted. The claim the entry rests on — independent dual ACCEPT 0/0 of v10 — was verified by opening both Stage A files rather than trusting the table: both are ACCEPT with zero blockers, zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX, and both reviewed subject digest 98cf4849…, the frozen v10. All seven citations recompute with zero mismatches. The non-unwrite span was parsed and contains exactly D-167 through D-188 with D-168 present and no gaps. Every live-state assertion — required-now 28 of 28, owners 32 of 32, Condition 2 at 4 of 32, Condition 4 MET, Condition 5 last, last gate row DR-G32, DR-G09 token OPEN, last heading D-188, frozen v3 at HEAD 5d5d778 and required-now 26 — was checked against the live file and holds exactly. The nine landed findings match v10's ledger identifier for identifier. The lineage claim over D-170 through D-188 was verified across all nineteen decisions. The sharpest available angle, that a recording act might silently record or upgrade the G09 harness specification, was examined and fails: the entry records only v10, attributes the authoring claim to the measurement, states 'Not QUALIFIED' twice, leaves file 08's contrary cell unedited, and is more explicit on the point than the adopted D-188 precedent it follows. Three further candidates were examined and recorded as observations because each is true as written rather than merely improvable. At zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX the decision rule yields CONSENT.
